question: Should this combined branch be the authoritative 0.38.4 release branch, including the Homebrew fix also proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1090?
rationale: Implementation and proof are strong, but release timing and branch authority cannot be inferred from code correctness; the repository currently has two open landing paths for the same workflow fix.

options.title: Use this combined branch
options.body: Merge this PR as the authoritative 0.38.4 release branch, then close the redundant narrower PR once the merge is confirmed.

options.title: Land the fix separately
options.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1090 first and recreate or rebase the 0.38.4 release metadata on the resulting main branch.

options.title: Defer the patch release
options.body: Pause both landing paths until the intended 0.38.4 contents and release timing are confirmed.

recommendation.title: Use this combined branch
recommendation.body: Merge this PR as the authoritative 0.38.4 release branch, then close the redundant narrower PR once the merge is confirmed.

likelyOwner.reason: They coordinated both overlapping branches and the serialized follow-up, making them the strongest available owner for confirming the intended release path.
